researchHypothesis: A fixed 10-month month-end close SMA filter may reduce exposure during sustained declines, at the cost of cash drag and whipsaw risk, versus holding the same 3-share quantity.

researchBasis.title: A Quantitative Approach to Tactical Asset Allocation
researchBasis.author: Mebane T. Faber
researchBasis.sourceRule: Update monthly on the last day of the month; buy when monthly price is above the 10-month SMA; sell to cash when below.
researchBasis.scopeLimit: The paper tests multiple asset classes; it does not establish that this rule works for Taiwan 0050.

economics.benchmark: Cost-matched always-long 3 shares using the same initial capital, fee, slippage, fill model, and terminal mark.
economics.distributionTreatment: Use the three documented post-split distribution events listed below; accrue entitlement from holdings before the ex-date close, then move receivable to cash on pay date; do not reinvest.
economics.taxTreatment: EXCLUDED; no taxpayer-specific tax model or complete tax input is available.
economics.cashYieldTreatment: ZERO; no cash-rate series is included, so cash returns are not imputed.

splitHandling.comparisonPriceScale: Multiply post-split raw close by 4 before comparing SMA values; retain pre-split raw close units. This keeps historical price comparisons exact without rounding fractional minor units.
splitHandling.partialFinalMonthRule: Do not generate an August 2026 monthly signal because the P194 archive ends on 2026-08-11 before that calendar month is complete.

interpretationLimits: Every P194 row and evaluation window predates this candidate review; none is a new unseen holdout.
This 0050 implementation is a retrospective adaptation, not a replication of the paper's total-return, close-of-signal execution, or Treasury-bill cash assumptions.
The raw-close signal does not adjust for distributions; portfolio wealth adds the three listed distribution entitlements separately.
Taxes are excluded and the limited recorded distribution schedule is not proof that all possible corporate actions were captured.
